heroTitle: A space to talk, at your own pace.
heroIntro: Hello, I’m David Billington. I offer counselling for adults online and in person in Horndean, Hampshire. You can bring whatever feels difficult, confusing or important. We can start there.
aboutTitle: You don't need to have it all figured out.
aboutText: Everyone experiences challenges and sometimes we need support to navigate them. I offer a private, confidential space where we can explore your thoughts, feelings and experiences together. My approach is shaped by you, with room to work at a pace that feels right.
supportIntro: I work with adults facing a range of experiences, including:
approachText: We can meet online, by phone or face to face in a private setting in Horndean. Online sessions can be helpful if travelling feels difficult or you feel more comfortable in a familiar space. We'll agree a regular time and check in on how things are going as we work together.
introTitle: A first conversation, with no pressure
introText: Choosing a counsellor can feel like a big step. I offer a free 20-minute phone call so you can ask questions, tell me what you're looking for and see whether working together feels right.
availability: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday, including evenings
contactText: You may know exactly what you need, or you may just want to talk it through. Send me a short message and I'll get back to you.
location: Horndean, Hampshire · online across the UK
